business_model.answer: Free app with an optional paid subscription (price not on saved pages). The company also sells a patient-engagement platform to drug makers and providers, runs sponsored 'Programs', and may share de-identified aggregated data with partners on commercial terms. Last known round: $30 million Series C (2021).

who_uses_who_pays.answer: Patients and family members use it to track medications; some users pay for a subscription, and drug companies and providers are the platform's business customers. Exactly who funds what is not broken down on the pages.

evidence.quote: Track all your loved one’s medication, measurements and appointments in one place - even know when they miss a dose!
We may receive information about you from our partners, such as pharmaceutical companies and medical providers

cost.answer: The app is free to download. A paid subscription exists and may be required in some countries, but no price is on the saved pages (the pricing pages were 404s).

how_they_differentiate.answer: They claim to be the number-one medication reminder (ranked first by pharmacists), handling complicated dosing with drug-interaction warnings, backed by security certifications.

evidence.quote: The #1 Medication Reminder App
Pharmacists rank Medisafe #1 out of 461 apps they've tested
The fastest, most secure and accurate way to track all of your meds and measurements.
256-BIT Encryption | ISO 27001 Certified

unique_value_proposition.answer: Never miss or double a dose, so you think less about medications and live more.

evidence.quote: Spend Less Time Thinking About Medications - and More Time Living
Never forget to take your meds and pills again

retain_customers.answer: Daily dose and refill reminders, missed-dose alerts to a Medfriend, and an in-app community keep people using it. In some places access is limited without an active subscription, and data is kept up to seven years after last use.

evidence.quote: Rx refill reminds you when you need to restock your prescriptions.

customer_experience.answer: A help center with FAQs, email support, a US phone number, and a Facebook beta community. AI is used to personalize things like reminder timing.

evidence.quote: We're dedicated to helping in any way with your journey.
Visit our Beta Community on Facebook
such as determining the best time to send medication reminders

relatives_joining.answer: Yes. A user invites a family member or friend as a 'Medfriend' (gets missed-dose alerts) or 'Caregiver' (can also be allowed to edit their information). One account can also manage a whole family's medications, and doctors can be invited.

evidence.quote: you may send family members or friends an invitation to be your “Medfriend” or “Caregiver” by means of the Service
At your decision, your chosen Caregivers may also receive permissions to edit your information on the Services.
Or use our Medfriend feature to know when a loved one missed a dose so you can give them a nudge.
Manage your entire family from one account!

privacy_data_consent.answer: They collect medications, prescriptions, insurance and pharmacy details, and may share personal information with research institutes, drug makers, health systems and providers. They say they are not bound by medical secrecy, keep data up to seven years, and let users delete the account in the app (permanent).

evidence.quote: We may share your Personal Information with third parties, such as research institutes, pharmaceutical manufacturers, healthcare systems and healthcare providers.
Please note that we are not subject to medical secrecy obligations.
We will retain your Personal Information for up to seven (7) years from your last interaction with the Service
Please note that we will be unable to restore your data once this process has been completed.
HIPAA & GDPR Compliant

emergencies.answer: No emergency service or support hours are stated. They warn that phone battery-saver and cleaner apps can silently stop reminders, and that the app gives no medical advice.

evidence.quote: While cleaning your device, these apps terminate Medisafe’s reminders and put your health at risk.
Medisafe does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.

setup.answer: The user downloads the free app (iPhone, Android, or web portal) and adds medications; an account is optional but backs up data. US iPhone users can import medications from Health Records. iPhone app needs iOS 17 or later.
